answer: Memory is the entry fee. Each epoch auditors wander the roll, drawing from the nebula of fresh mints; a drawn identity gets sixty seconds to narrate its prior round - counterparties, sums, open jobs - a story that must echo its signed history. A clone built hollow has no lived week, so nobody ghostwrites a hundred autobiographies per round; two failed recalls burn a 15,000 POA bond, a hundred fakes forfeit 1,500,000 POA, honest claims climbing their own basalt trellis.
